arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: John Howley argued these are tax enforcement lawsuits.
He stated the only issue is whether a tax is owed.
Vikram Srinivasan argued tax actions are not property cases.
He said attaching a lien does not change the case nature.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on whether a tax lien creates a real property right. India's mission says the case remains a tax dispute. New York City says the lien makes it a property case.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the scope of diplomatic immunity for tax debts. It determines whether cities can collect taxes from foreign missions. The outcome affects municipal finances and international relations.
